candidates.description: This feature vector represents the concept of quantifying an unspecified, plural number of items or instances across multiple languages.
This feature vector represents psychoactive substances, intoxicants, and related addictive substances.
These tokens represent chemical, biological, and medical prefixes and root morphemes.
This vector represents the concept of utilization, encompassing variations of the root words for "use" across multiple languages.
This feature vector represents adverbial discourse markers and conjunctions across multiple languages used to indicate logical transition, consequence, or qualification.
This feature activates for terms related to medical dosages, drug potency, and administration concentrations.
This feature vector activates on tokens containing or related to the phonetic and orthographic root "eff/aff/effect".
This feature vector represents adverbial modifiers of degree and intensity across multiple languages.
This vector detects the Latin root meaning one or single, appearing in words like unary and unity.
This vector activates strongly on common German auxiliary and modal verbs across various tenses and conjugations.
